season.evidence: Stored Jun-Sep with Jul-Aug best; the only logged successful ascents of this route are in July, and the peak's all-route months run Jun-Sep. Stored season stands.

track.why: Logged route is Blue's Buttress, summited 2025-07-29; track passes 8 m from our Summit pin and its highest point is 46 m from it. The recording starts at the buttress base (1.4 km from our trailhead pin) and ends 45 m from the hairpin trailhead pin, so it covers climb plus descent and walk-out but not the approach in; it is not a full round trip.

notes: Only one track exists and its trip report holds no route facts. Peakbagger's surveyed summit (48.5064,-120.6529) is 1.2 km from ours, but it is a topographic-map value and the track's highest point agrees with our pin, so no summit move is proposed. Our pin list labels 'Blue Lake trailhead roadside parking' as type Campsite; it is not a camp.
